english.title: Applicant for a new / renewal / variation of a scrap metal licence fail to notify authority of changes
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an applicant for

(A)_[a scrap metal licence,]_
(B)_[the renewal of a scrap metal licence,]_
(C)_[the variation of a scrap metal licence,]_

failed to notify the authority to which an application was made, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..), of a change which materially affected the accuracy of the information which you had provided in connection with the application, namely **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF THE CHANGE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(1) and (9) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes: It is a defence for a person charged with this offence to prove that they took all reasonable steps to avoid committing the offence (section 8(10)).
